Acupressure.name: Acupressure
Acupressure.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

Barb Barrage.name: Barb Barrage
Barb Barrage.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
Barb Barrage.shortDesc: 30% psn. Power doubles if the target is statused.
Barb Barrage.rrText: 30% psn. Power doubles if the target is statused.

Beat Up.name: Beat Up
Beat Up.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

Bitter Malice.name: Bitter Malice
Bitter Malice.desc: Has a 30% chance to freeze the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
Bitter Malice.shortDesc: 30% frz. Power doubles if the target is statused.
Bitter Malice.rrText: 30% frz. Power doubles if the target is statused.

Blast Burn.name: Blast Burn
Blast Burn.desc: Has a 60% chance to burn the target. If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move, unless the target or its substitute was knocked out by this move.
Blast Burn.shortDesc: 60% brn. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.
Blast Burn.rrText: 60% brn. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.

Bleakwind Storm.name: Bleakwind Storm
Bleakwind Storm.desc: Has a 20% chance to freeze the target.

Charge Beam.name: Charge Beam
Charge Beam.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Charge Beam.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
Charge Beam.rrText: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

Chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
Chloroblast.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 50% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Dark Hole.name: Dark Hole
Dark Hole.shortDesc: 40% chance to inflict sleep, bypasses substitute.
Dark Hole.rrText: 40% chance to inflict sleep, bypasses substitute.

Dire Claw.name: Dire Claw
Dire Claw.desc: Has a 50% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.

Double Team.name: Double Team
Double Team.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

Draco Barrage.name: Draco Barrage
Draco Barrage.desc: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP. This move can hit Fairy-type Pokemon.
Draco Barrage.shortDesc: Physical if Atk > Sp. Atk. 33% recoil. Hits fairies.
Draco Barrage.rrText: Physical if Atk > Sp. Atk. 33% recoil. Hits fairies.

Explosion.name: Explosion
Explosion.desc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. The target's Defense is halved during damage calculation. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
Explosion.shortDesc: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.
Explosion.rrText: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.

Facade.name: Facade
Facade.desc: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or frozen. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

Flash.name: Flash
Flash.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Flash.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
Flash.rrText: 50% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

Forbidden Spell.name: Forbidden Spell
Forbidden Spell.desc: Uses of one of these 8 moves: Shell Smash, Healing Wish, Dark Hole, Tail Glow, Roar of Time, Quiver Dance, No Retreat, or Soul Robbery

Frenzy Plant.name: Frenzy Plant
Frenzy Plant.desc: Has an 80% chance to badly poison the target. If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move, unless the target or its substitute was knocked out by this move.
Frenzy Plant.shortDesc: 80% tox. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.
Frenzy Plant.rrText: 80% tox. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.

Frost Breath.name: Frost Breath
Frost Breath.desc: Has a 30% chance to freeze the target. This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
Frost Breath.shortDesc: 30% frz. Always results in a critical hit.
Frost Breath.rrText: 30% frz. Always results in a critical hit.

Head Charge.name: Head Charge
Head Charge.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Head Charge.shortDesc: Has 1/4 recoil. 10% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
Head Charge.rrText: Has 1/4 recoil. 10% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

Hydro Cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
Hydro Cannon.desc: Has a 60% chance to freeze the target. If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move, unless the target or its substitute was knocked out by this move.
Hydro Cannon.shortDesc: 60% frz. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.
Hydro Cannon.rrText: 60% frz. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.

Infernal Parade.name: Infernal Parade
Infernal Parade.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
Infernal Parade.shortDesc: 30% brn. Power doubles if the target is statused.
Infernal Parade.rrText: 30% brn. Power doubles if the target is statused.

Jaw Lock.name: Jaw Lock
Jaw Lock.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
Jaw Lock.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.
Jaw Lock.rrText: Prevents the target from switching out.

King's Shield.name: King's Shield
King's Shield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Meteor Assault.name: Meteor Assault
Meteor Assault.desc: Has a 60% chance to paralyze the target. If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move, unless the target or its substitute was knocked out by this move.
Meteor Assault.shortDesc: 60% par. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.
Meteor Assault.rrText: 60% par. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.

Minimize.name: Minimize
Minimize.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

Misty Explosion.name: Misty Explosion
Misty Explosion.desc: If the current terrain is Misty Terrain and the user is grounded, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. The target's Defense is halved during damage calculation. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
Misty Explosion.shortDesc: Sp. Def halved; Misty Terrain: 1.5x power.
Misty Explosion.rrText: Sp. Def halved; Misty Terrain: 1.5x power.

Muddy Water.name: Muddy Water
Muddy Water.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Muddy Water.shortDesc: 40% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.
Muddy Water.rrText: 40% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.

Multi-Attack.name: Multi-Attack
Multi-Attack.desc: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.
Multi-Attack.shortDesc: Type varies based on the user's primary type.
Multi-Attack.rrText: Type varies based on the user's primary type.

Octazooka.name: Octazooka
Octazooka.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's speed by 1 stage.
Octazooka.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's speed by 1.
Octazooka.rrText: 100% chance to lower the target's speed by 1.

Prismatic Laser.name: Prismatic Laser
Prismatic Laser.desc: Has a 50% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move, unless the target or its substitute was knocked out by this move.
Prismatic Laser.shortDesc: 50% slp. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.
Prismatic Laser.rrText: 50% slp. Can't move next turn if target is not KOed.

Psyshield Bash.name: Psyshield Bash
Psyshield Bash.desc: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
Psyshield Bash.shortDesc: 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.
Psyshield Bash.rrText: 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

Raging Bull.name: Raging Bull
Raging Bull.desc: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.
Raging Bull.shortDesc: Type varies based on the user's primary type.
Raging Bull.rrText: Type varies based on the user's primary type.

Razor Shell.name: Razor Shell
Razor Shell.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Refresh.name: Refresh
Refresh.desc: The user cures its burn, poison, paralysis, or freeze. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, paralyzed, or frozen.
Refresh.shortDesc: User cures its burn, poison, paralysis, or freeze.
Refresh.rrText: User cures its burn, poison, paralysis, or freeze.

Roar of Time.name: Roar of Time
Roar of Time.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
Roar of Time.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
Roar of Time.rrText: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

Rock Slide.name: Rock Slide
Rock Slide.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Rock Slide.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
Rock Slide.rrText: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

Sand Attack.name: Sand Attack
Sand Attack.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Self-Destruct.name: Self-Destruct
Self-Destruct.desc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. The target's Defense is halved during damage calculation. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
Self-Destruct.shortDesc: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.
Self-Destruct.rrText: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.

Shell Side Arm.name: Shell Side Arm
Shell Side Arm.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
Shell Side Arm.shortDesc: 10% psn; ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.
Shell Side Arm.rrText: 10% psn; ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.

Skull Bash.name: Skull Bash
Skull Bash.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Skull Bash.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack and Defense by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.
Skull Bash.rrText: Raises user's Attack and Defense by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.

Smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
Smokescreen.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Sonic Slash.name: Sonic Slash
Sonic Slash.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 140 if the result is 3 or more, 120 if 2, 80 if less than 2. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 80.
Sonic Slash.shortDesc: 140 BP if 3x target's speed; 120 BP if 2x; else 80 BP.
Sonic Slash.rrText: 140 BP if 3x target's speed; 120 BP if 2x; else 80 BP.

Soul Robbery.name: Soul Robbery
Soul Robbery.desc: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.
Soul Robbery.shortDesc: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.
Soul Robbery.rrText: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.

Thunder Wave.name: Thunder Wave
Thunder Wave.desc: Paralyzes the target. If a Electric-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. This move does not ignore type immunity.
Thunder Wave.shortDesc: Paralyzes the target. Electric types can't miss.
Thunder Wave.rrText: Paralyzes the target. Electric types can't miss.

Triple Kick.name: Triple Kick
Triple Kick.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
Triple Kick.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.
Triple Kick.rrText: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

Volt Tackle.name: Volt Tackle
Volt Tackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Volt Tackle.shortDesc: Has 1/4 recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.
Volt Tackle.rrText: Has 1/4 recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

Wide Guard.name: Wide Guard
Wide Guard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This attack has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and doubles each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this attack fails or if the user's last used move is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. If X is 256 or more, this move has a 1/(2^32) chance of being successful. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
Wide Guard.shortDesc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.
Wide Guard.rrText: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

Will-O-Wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
Will-O-Wisp.desc: Burns the target. If a Fire-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
Will-O-Wisp.shortDesc: Burns the target. Fire types can't miss.
Will-O-Wisp.rrText: Burns the target. Fire types can't miss.

Zippy Zap.name: Zippy Zap
Zippy Zap.desc: Will always result in a critical hit.

badcompany.text: Prevents self-lowering stat drops and recoil.

blazingsoul.text: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Fire-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

blubberdefense.text: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

bonezone.text: Bone moves ignore immunities and deal double damage on not very effective.

bullrush.text: On the first turn this Pokemon is out on the field for, it gets a 1.5x Speed boost and a 1.2x Attack boost.

cashsplash.text: This Pokemon's attacking stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's attacking stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

corrosion.text: This Pokemon can hit Steel types with Poison-type moves.

defeatist.text: While this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.

emergencyexit.text: At the end of the turn, if this Pokemon has less than 1/2 of its maximum HP, it switches out to a chosen ally.

fatalprecision.text: Super Effective Moves from this Pokemon can’t miss and receive a 20% damage boost.

felineprowess.text: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is doubled.

flareboost.text: While this Pokemon is burned, the power of its special attacks is multiplied by 1.5. Immune to burn damage.

flowergift.text: If this Pokemon is a Cherrim and Sunny Day is active, it changes to Sunshine Form and its Attack and Speed are multiplied by 1.5. If this Pokemon is a Cherrim and it is holding Utility Umbrella, it remains in its regular form and its Attack and Speed stats are not boosted. If this Pokemon is a Cherrim in its Sunshine form and is given Utility Umbrella, it will immediately switch back to its regular form. If this Pokemon is a Cherrim holding Utility Umbrella and its item is removed while Sunny Day is active, it will transform into its Sunshine Form.

forecast.text: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. If this Pokemon is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather condition is Sunny Day, Desolate Land, Rain Dance, or Primordial Sea, it will not change types. If this pokemon is holding a weather rock, it will set the weather corrosponding to the rock it is holding.

gulpmissile.text: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.

illuminate.text: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.2.

illusion.text: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon. This Pokemon's moves are given a 1.3x boost when disguised.

ironfist.text: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3.

liquidvoice.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

mountaineer.text: This Pokemon is immune to Rock; Avoids Stealth Rock.

oraoraoraora.text: This Pokemon's punch moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage halved.

parasiticwaste.text: Attacks that can poison also heal for 50% of the damage dealt.

phoenixdown.text: Once per battle, this Pokemon restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, has its non-volatile status condition cured, and has its stat stages reset to 0 instead of fainting.

primalarmor.text: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from supereffective attacks.

quickfeet.text: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 2; the Speed drop from paralysis is ignored.

quillrush.text: On the first turn this Pokemon is out on the field for, it gets a 1.5x Speed boost and a 1.2x Attack boost.

rivalry.text: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless, or if they have different genders.

sagepower.text: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

selfsufficient.text: At the end of every turn, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its max HP.

shielddust.text: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack, and is not affected by entry hazards.

solarpower.text: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5. If this Pokemon is holding Utility Umbrella, its Special Attack remains the same.

striker.text: This Pokemon's kick-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3.

toxicboost.text: While this Pokemon is poisoned, the power of its physical attacks is multiplied by 1.5. Immune to poison damage.

truant.text: This Pokemon can only use healing moves every other turn.

watercompaction.text: This Pokemon takes 50% less damage from Water-type moves, and its Defense is raised 2 stages after it is hit by one.

zenmode.text: If this Pokemon is a Darmanitan, Darmanitan-Galar, or Darmanitan-Bee, it changes to Zen Mode on switch-in. This Ability cannot be removed or suppressed.

brokenmetalbody.text: When hit by a physical attack, sets G-Max Steelsurge on the opposing side.

chilllikethat.text: On switch-in, this Pokemon raises its Attack by 6 stages.

thelook.text: While this Pokemon is active, opposing Pokemon cannot use the same move twice in a row.

commissioner.text: At the end of each turn, this Pokemon randomly gains +1 Speed, gives a foe Torment, gains +1 Defense, forces a foe out, or gains Aqua Ring.

gobeyond.text: This Pokemon's moves ignore abilities, and this Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat changes when taking or dealing damage.

gearsturning.text: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5.

vocalizer.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

assholesinsufferableness.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 3.

unbothered.text: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch or become affected by Taunt.

jumpscare.text: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's attacks have their damage multiplied by 1.3. When this Pokemon's disguise breaks, a GIF is displayed.
